name: choice-lang
description: The first executable model of choice as a language primitive — the #15 milestone body that does not need hardware. The ledger's OPEN row said 'no executable model exists'; this repo is one. A minimal language whose choose(w, U0, U1) nodes compile to controlled-unitary branching on (control, data); the desired world is a marked subspace W; ENGINEERED programs (branches preserving W) keep data-in-W with fidelity exactly 1 over arbitrary program lengths while random programs decay to the dimension ratio; certifying 'the world we want' reopens the epoch-3 ledger toll 1/P at the language layer; the choice register steers but never broadcasts; and the conservation law that guards stability is exhibited in-model: invariance implies the membership charge is conserved implies stability. v0.2.0 adds the language's own composition faces: sequential composition is a homomorphism (product-measure weights, chaining conditionings, associating denotation products), nested choose(choose(A,B),C) is context-free but NOT interchangeable with choose(A,choose(B,C)) — same denotations on common leaves, different prices (the honest negative, exact identity AND exact counterexample), the certification toll multiplies under composition and compounds as w^k over bounded loops whose charge ledger telescopes without accumulating rounding, the conserved charge survives both composition forms, and in a two-player census the toll is strategy-proof (branch-blind in every cell) while the charge is the attack surface. The checker enforces the model laws including a law-citation registry that names and rejects counterfeit composition identities and fake toll laws; the renderer refuses illegal models. The epoch-5 superstructure question (stability as physics, not compilation) stays OPEN and is not claimed.
